edits.new: For each child alternative, identify every parent alternative or permitted connection that could cover it, and assign each required condition to the alternative or connection whose wording imposes it. Keep those assignments unchanged in the questions, answers and canonical tests. Establish exclusion from each alternative or connection using its own requirements; a condition imposed by another alternative cannot exclude it.
edits.old: For each child alternative, identify every parent alternative or permitted connection that could cover it. Conditions restrict their own alternatives.
